basic_info.description: Don't let the proximity to Market St fool you - 78 Stanton is a 3bd/3ba Victorian abode situated in a cul-de-sac just steps away from Kite Hill, Castro and Downtown Noe Valley. The versatile 2,163 SF (per graphic artist) property can serve as a 2-family dwelling or a single-family home with income potential. The main residence, a 2-bed, 2-bath, 1,443 SF (per graphic artist) features a formal living room w/ projection screen, an updated chef's kitchen with Wolf range and high-end appliances and immediately adjacent to the dining room - ideal for entertaining. 2 light-filled bedrooms and washer/dryer on the upper level, including a primary suite with private deck. The fully equipped lower unit is a 1bd/1ba, 720 SF (per graphic artist), and offers a separate entrance, deck, full kitchen, in-unit laundry, and ample storage. Beautifully landscaped front and rear yards, two exterior storage sheds, 2024-installed roof. Easy access to Kite Hill at the end of the cul-de-sac leads you down to access shops, bars and restaurants along Castro Street. Close proximity to downtown Noe Valley, and Harvey Milk Plaza for easy public transit to downtown, FIDI, etc.
